name: iina-streams
description: Twitch and YouTube streaming plugin for IINA with draggable glassy chat overlay, read-only Twitch chat, and automatic VOD replay.

scripts.test:all: npm run check:version && npm test && npm run test:py
scripts.install-beta: npm run build:beta && rm -rf "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.colliderli.iina/plugins/local.iina.streams.beta.iinaplugin" && cp -R dist/beta/streams-beta.iinaplugin "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.colliderli.iina/plugins/local.iina.streams.beta.iinaplugin"
